fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix former senior researcher analyst Lee Joo-wan maintains Samsung Electronics target price of KRW 70,000 and SK Hynix target price of KRW 200,000, warning that stock prices may decline further when memory prices begin to weaken.
fields.summary_ko.1: The supercycle in memory semiconductors already peaked in Q3, with price declines expected to fall 50% within one year and 90% within two years, while Nvidia is currently assessed as a bubble.
